WITH group_rates AS (
  SELECT s.riskeval, SUM(sc.gbsize) / SUM(sc.spanmin) AS rate
  FROM scans AS sc
  JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = sc.zoneref
  GROUP BY s.riskeval
), benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(rate) AS avg_rate FROM group_rates
)
SELECT AVG(gr.rate) AS avg_rate_above_benchmark,
       AVG(gr.rate - b.avg_rate) AS avg_excess_above_benchmark
FROM group_rates AS gr
CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b
WHERE gr.rate > b.avg_rate;
